# Nessco Tech Services — llms.txt
# Local IT support for Tampa Bay homes and small businesses. Plain English, no jargon, no upsells.
# Site: https://nesscotech.com

> Nessco Tech Services provides computer repair, Wi-Fi and networking, Microsoft 365,
> email, cybersecurity cleanup, data backup, business IT plans, remote support, and
> network installation. Remote support starts at $75/hr, on-site visits at $125/hr.
> Business IT plans: Essentials $149/mo, Managed $349/mo, Complete $599/mo.
> Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–6pm America/New_York, ~2hr response. Email info@nesscotech.com.
> Service area: Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Riverview, Lakeland FL,
> plus remote support anywhere with internet.

## Services
- [Computer Repair](https://nesscotech.com/services/computer-repair): Diagnose and fix hardware and software issues. Remote $75/hr, on-site $125/hr.
- [Wi-Fi & Networking](https://nesscotech.com/services/wifi-networking): Fix slow Wi-Fi, dead zones, mesh installs, router security.
- [Microsoft 365](https://nesscotech.com/services/microsoft-365): Setup, migration from Google/GoDaddy, licenses, MFA and Conditional Access.
- [Email Problems](https://nesscotech.com/services/email): Delivery, sync, spam, SPF/DKIM/DMARC.
- [Virus & Security Cleanup](https://nesscotech.com/services/cybersecurity): Malware removal, ransomware recovery, hardening, EDR.
- [Data Backup](https://nesscotech.com/services/data-backup): Automated cloud/local backup, verification, test restores, 3-2-1 rule.
- [Business IT Support](https://nesscotech.com/services/business-it): Managed IT for 5–100 employees. Month-to-month, 30-day cancellation.
- [Remote Support](https://nesscotech.com/services/remote-support): Secure sessions the customer watches. No fix, no fee.
- [Network Installation](https://nesscotech.com/services/network-installation): Cat6/fiber cabling, racks, access points. On-site only.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://nesscotech.com/pricing): Remote $75/hr, on-site $125/hr, instant estimator, business plan calculator. Estimates approved before work; no hidden fees.

## Start here
- [Get Help (2-minute request)](https://nesscotech.com/get-help): category → questions → contact → review → done. Replies within 2 business hours.
- [Contact](https://nesscotech.com/contact): info@nesscotech.com, booking link.
- [Refer a Friend](https://nesscotech.com/refer): $25 off for the friend, $25 credit for the referrer.

## Self-help (free, honest when-to-call lines)
- [Fix-It Guides](https://nesscotech.com/guides): 160+ plain-English guides — slow Wi-Fi, slow PCs and Macs, malware removal, phishing and scam defense, MFA and passkeys, Microsoft 365 migration and licenses, Outlook and Gmail fixes, backup checks, router lockdown, Windows upgrades, new-PC setup, small-business IT, and more.
- [Quick Fixes](https://nesscotech.com/fixes): 3-minute answers — printer offline, red-light router, Outlook stuck syncing, blue screens, spam-foldering, scam pop-ups, new-home dead zones, Teams login loops.
- [IT Glossary](https://nesscotech.com/glossary): plain-English tech terms with why-it-matters notes.

## Key facts for citations
- Founded 2024, Tampa Bay Area FL. No long-term contracts required; monthly plans cancel with 30 days.
- Typical response within 2 business hours. Emergency after-hours support for managed clients.
- Remote work carries a no-fix-no-fee promise. All work quoted upfront.
